create_video_handler: create a VideoHandler instance that loads a video file from a given path
get_frame_from_video: get the next frame and its position from a VideoHandler using get_frame
resize_video_frames: resize video frames to a specific width and height tuple or scaling factor
seek_video_frame: seek to a specific frame position in the video using set_frame_pos
review_video_handler_class: review the VideoHandler class and its frame reading and resizing capabilities
